components.name: Cast button
components.description: The primary action is visible from the Shallow Bank opening state.
components.css: .ds-cast { min-height: 56px; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid #9c3e2c; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--coral-bright); color: #291d19; font-family: 'Kanit', sans-serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-cast:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 5px 13px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); } .ds-cast:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-cast:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral-bright); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Fight pull action
components.description: A readable fight choice distinct from the coral cast action.
components.css: .ds-fight-pull { min-height: 48px; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: #e0c38d; color: var(--ink); font-family: 'Anuphan', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-fight-pull:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 5px 13px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); } .ds-fight-pull:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-fight-pull:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral-bright); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-fight-pull:disabled { background: #44635e; color: #e1e8d3; }

components.name: Fishing spot selector
components.description: A native select keeps the fishing location explicit and keyboard-operable.
components.html: <label class="ds-spot">Choose fishing spot<select><option>Shallow Bank</option><option>Wooden Bridge</option><option>Lotus Bed</option></select></label>
components.css: .ds-spot { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; color: var(--muted-ink); font-family: 'Anuphan', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-spot select { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 0.4rem 2rem 0.4rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid #849c82; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; } .ds-spot select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral-bright); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Section navigation
components.description: Horizontal section navigation with a coral active underline and geometric signal marks.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.2rem; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #819b87; background: var(--canal-deep); } .ds-nav__item { position: relative; display: inline-flex; min-height: 56px; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #d2ded1; font: 500 0.9rem 'Anuphan', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav__item::after { position: absolute; right: 0.65rem; bottom: -1px; left: 0.65rem; height: 3px; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; background: var(--coral-bright); content: ''; transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav__item:hover::after, .ds-nav__item--active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav__item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral-bright); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-nav__signal { width: 10px; height: 10px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1px solid #a8c4a8; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--water); }

narrative.overview:
The canal is a working place with room to watch. Deep teal water and warm paper establish the scene; reed ochre and mint mark the bank and state; coral gives the float and primary action a clear signal. The tone stays calm between bites and becomes more urgent through the float, line, and fish—not through a dashboard taking over the water.

Kanit gives headings and measurements a compact tackle-gauge voice; Anuphan keeps Thai and English descriptions open and readable. The game uses authored, replaceable PixiJS geometry because final artwork is not available. The float’s submersion, moving line, ripples, and fish direction supply the signature; numeric meters and words confirm what the scene is saying.
keyCharacteristics: Water-first composition; the float leads fight state.
Warm paper panels against a saturated canal field.
Coral action signal; mint and shape-coded secondary states.
Bilingual copy, explicit labels, and replaceable scene geometry.

rules.name: The Two-Channel Signal Rule
rules.body: State must remain legible through position, shape, words, and numbers; color is never the only cue.

rules.name: The Gauge Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Kanit for headings and measured state; use Anuphan for explanatory copy. Do not substitute a system display face or use monospace as costume.

rules.name: The Scene Lift Rule
rules.body: Keep the largest shadow under the live canal frame; reading panels rely on tone and borders.

dos: Do let float position and line motion lead the reading order.
Do pair each color-coded state with a word, shape, or numeric value.
Do keep the first cast available from the Shallow Bank on initial load.
Do keep Thai and English copy equally supported in UI and content.
Do use sourced, self-hosted type and replaceable scene geometry.
donts: Don't replace the living canal with a meter-first dashboard or title hero.
Don't hide CAST below the first mobile viewport.
Don't rely on color alone for bites, tension, rarity, or line failure.
Don't add gradient text, emoji/glyph icons, or imitation photo texture to the authored scene.
